_doc: Themes are templates for the generator. stages is an ordered pool: the first and last are always used, the generator picks the middle ones in order. kind is what the stage looks like (manual / semi / auto). Add a theme to add a workflow; no code changes.

themes.title: Order to cash
themes.intro: Orders arrive as PDFs and get retyped into the ERP. Find what really holds the line up.

stages.name: Order received
stages.description: Orders land in the shared inbox and the web shop.

stages.name: Manual PDF copy-paste
stages.description: Someone opens each PDF and retypes customer, lines and prices.

stages.name: Credit check
stages.description: Finance checks the customer's limit in a separate system.

stages.name: Stock allocation
stages.description: Warehouse stock is reserved against each order line.

stages.name: ERP entry
stages.description: Clean data is posted into the ERP. Mostly clicks, some checks.

stages.name: Price exceptions
stages.description: Special prices are checked against an Excel list.

stages.name: Delivery booking
stages.description: A coordinator books transport by email and phone.

stages.name: Invoice sent
stages.description: The ERP generates and emails the invoice.

themes.title: Supplier invoices
themes.intro: Invoices land in a shared inbox and get matched to purchase orders by eye.

stages.name: Invoice arrives by email
stages.description: Invoices arrive in a shared mailbox and are filed automatically.

stages.name: Scan and read invoice
stages.description: Paper and PDF invoices are read and keyed in by hand.

stages.name: Manual matching to PO
stages.description: Someone compares invoice, purchase order and goods receipt line by line.

stages.name: Coding to accounts
stages.description: Each line is coded to a cost centre from a lookup table.

stages.name: Exception handling
stages.description: Mismatches go into an email thread with the supplier.

stages.name: Approval chain
stages.description: Invoices wait for two managers to click approve.

stages.name: VAT check
stages.description: Tax codes are checked before posting.

stages.name: Payment run
stages.description: Approved invoices are bundled into the bank file.

themes.title: New hire onboarding
themes.intro: A hiring wave is coming. Several steps look slow. Only some really are.

stages.name: Offer signed
stages.description: E-signature is already automatic.

stages.name: Collect documents by email
stages.description: HR chases bank details, tax cards and ID copies one email at a time.

stages.name: Background checks
stages.description: Checks are ordered from a provider and tracked in a sheet.

stages.name: Set up accounts and equipment
stages.description: IT creates logins and orders a laptop from a spreadsheet checklist.

stages.name: Contracts and payroll entry
stages.description: Contract data is keyed into payroll by hand.

stages.name: Benefits enrolment
stages.description: Forms are emailed, filled in and re-entered.

stages.name: Training bookings
stages.description: A coordinator books courses and rooms.

stages.name: Day-one schedule
stages.description: The first-week calendar is sent to the new hire and the team.
